description: This Java class is a Spring MVC controller managing payment-related admin functionalities including viewing, configuring, and deleting payment methods within a web application.

classes.name: PaymentsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling payment method views and configurations in admin panel

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list available and configured payment methods

methods.name: displayPaymentMethod
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show a specific payment method configuration form

methods.name: savePaymentMethod
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save updates to a payment method configuration

methods.name: deletePaymentMethod
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a specific payment method configuration

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up menu context for views
